tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Runs a read-only SQL query against the reporting database and returns up to 500 rows.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Returns the columns and types of a table in the reporting database.

tools.name: export_rows
tools.description: Exports query results to a CSV file in the exports folder.

tools.name: read_connection_env
tools.description: Reads the database connection settings from the environment and the .env file for diagnostics.
